# Ferren Cafe

Wholesale account, current as of **2026-06-14**.

- **85 loaves per week** — 60 sourdough, 25 tin. Below the 120-loaf threshold, so
  they are **not** on the volume tier and pay list price from
  [pricing](pricing.md).
- **Two years on the account**, no missed invoices, no volume changes since the
  first quarter.
- **One site**, 2.1 km from the bakery, on the standard 06:30 drop under
  [the wholesale bread programme](wholesale-bread-programme.md).
- **Open question as of 2026-06-14:** they have asked about a second drop on
  Saturdays. Not answered, and it falls outside the programme's terms — the
  decision route is [trading policy](../standing/trading-policy.md).

**Confidentiality.** This page is for answering about Ferren Cafe. Their volumes,
tier position and history do not appear in work for any other account, in
outward-facing drafts, or in an aggregate across accounts. Anything they will
read themselves is drafted from this page plus the offer and standing policy —
no other account's page is opened for it. See
[order intake](order-intake.md) for how their weekly variations are handled.
